name: RestoRuzz
detailed_description:
Welcome to RestoRuzz E — the most chaotic restaurant under the sea!
Get ready for a fast-paced, laughter-filled cooking experience where teamwork, time management, and quick thinking are the key ingredients to success. Designed for 1–4 players, RestoRuzz E is a vibrant couch co-op restaurant sim that blends frantic food prep, unpredictable customer behavior, and roguelite-style progression into one deliciously challenging game.

Work side by side with your friends (or solo!) to take customer orders, cook dishes through mini-games, and serve food before time runs out. But don’t get too comfortable—each session comes with random events, changing restaurant layouts, and escalating chaos that keep you on your toes every round. As you earn money, you’ll be able to upgrade your kitchen, unlock new recipes, and promote your restaurant to attract even more hungry (and sometimes demanding) customers.

Key Features:

  • 👨‍🍳 Chaotic Co-op Cooking: Team up locally with up to 4 players and coordinate your kitchen like pros—or embrace the beautiful disaster of total mayhem.

  • 🎮 Interactive Cooking Mini-Games: Chop, fry, plate, and serve using fun, fast-paced minigames that test your multitasking skills.

  • 🛠️ Upgrade Your Restaurant: Use your hard-earned cash to buy new equipment, expand your kitchen, and unlock strategic upgrades.

  • 🌈 Colorful 2D Art Style: Dive into a cartoony underwater world full of quirky characters, charming animations, and vibrant kitchens.

  • 🧠 Strategic Teamwork: Delegate roles, manage time, and adapt quickly as chaos builds with every order.

  • 🏠 Designed for Local Multiplayer: Perfect for families, friends, and party gaming nights (supports both keyboard and controller).

Whether you're a solo chef or part of a full kitchen crew, RestoRuzz E will test your skills, your friendships, and your ability to cook under pressure. Are you ready to build the ultimate restaurant empire—one dish at a time?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Ryzen 3 1200 / Intel i5-4570
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 600 / Intel HD Graphics 520
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Game may experience short stutters on very low-end devices, especially on first load or in hectic gameplay moments.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel i5-10400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 250 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for smooth gameplay in multiplayer sessions and when playing on higher resolutions.
